title: What Is an Oxymoron? — Learn with Examples
skills: define oxymoron as a literary device
identify contradictory word pairings in texts
analyze how oxymorons create emphasis, tension, or irony
explain how oxymorons contribute to tone and meaning
alignment_note: Introduces oxymoron as the deliberate pairing of contradictory or opposing terms to create emphasis, complexity, irony, or stylistic effect. Supports figurative-language analysis, close reading, interpretation of tone, and author's craft across high school English courses.
